name: Zerah
overview: The name Zerah appears in Scripture as a figure connected to various lineages and roles. He is identified as a son of Reuel, one of Esau's sons, with his descendants recognized as chiefs in Edom (Genesis 36:13,17; 1 Chronicles 1:37). Additionally, Zerah is noted as the father of Jobab, who succeeded Bela as king of Edom in Bozrah (Genesis 36:33; 1 Chronicles 1:44). The family of Zerah also includes the Zarhites, a Levitical clan, highlighting his association with the tribe of Levi (Numbers 26:13). These references collectively show Zerah's significance in both genealogical and leadership contexts within God's providential plan.
